verdict.rationale: The docs show a short bring-up path: a one-line `claude mcp add sai ... npx -y @simular-ai/sai-mcp` install with an API key, then sending a plain-language task that Sai completes on a cloud Windows computer, with progress streamed via `GET /v1/agents/events`. Nothing in the pack shows a dedicated step-by-step quickstart, and no one confirms getting from install to a finished task using the docs alone. missing for 10: an explicit quickstart guide covering install → API key → first task → result, any hands-on or independent confirmation of time-to-first-task, and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
